QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Precious Ore
QuestInfo.0: Speak with Eremos about the Lidium you just obtained.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos has asked you to collect Ariant's valuable mineral, but why the Ryuul like minerals so much remains a mystery. It was considered a precious mineral a long time ago, but not so much now. Eremos is willing to reward you for the Lidium though.
